questions.question: What requirement must be met for modern web browsers to permit automated video playback using 'autoplay'?
options: The 'muted' attribute must also be specified on the <video> tag
The 'controls' attribute must be omitted entirely
The video file must be encoded exclusively in WebM format
The 'loop' attribute must be enabled
questions.explanation: Browser autonomy policies strictly enforce that unmuted video cannot autoplay to avoid startling users with unsolicited sound.

questions.question: What is the function of the boolean 'controls' attribute on the HTML5 <video> element?
options: It renders browser playback controls including play/pause, seek track, and volume slider
It enables hardware acceleration on user GPUs
It prevents users from right-clicking to download the video
It forces the media player into a full-viewport modal
questions.explanation: The 'controls' attribute directs the browser to present native user playback controls.

questions.question: Which attribute on the <video> tag designates a thumbnail preview image prior to playback?
options: thumbnail
preview
poster
cover
questions.explanation: The 'poster' attribute specifies an image URL displayed until the user initiates video playback.

questions.question: Why is it best practice to enclose multiple <source> elements within an <audio> or <video> tag?
options: To play multiple media channels simultaneously
To provide fallback formats (e.g. MP4, WebM) across different browser codec implementations
To enhance video compression speed by 50%
To inject subtitles automatically into the media pipeline
questions.explanation: Different browsers support distinct audio/video codecs; multiple sources offer robust compatibility fallbacks.

questions.question: Which HTML element is the standard mechanism to embed third-party media like YouTube or interactive maps?
options: <embed-video>
<iframe>
<plugin>
<portal>
questions.explanation: The <iframe> (Inline Frame) encloses an external browsing context to embed videos, maps, and widgets.

questions.question: Which attribute causes an HTML5 media element to automatically replay once it concludes?
options: repeat
replay
loop
continuous
questions.explanation: The 'loop' boolean attribute instructs the browser to seamlessly restart media playback upon reaching the end.

questions.question: What capability does the 'allowfullscreen' attribute grant to an embedded <iframe> video player?
options: It authorizes the embedded player to expand across the user's entire monitor display
It forces the outer website into kiosk mode
It hides browser navigation chrome permanently
It locks screen orientation to landscape
questions.explanation: The 'allowfullscreen' attribute explicitly delegates fullscreen API capabilities to the nested frame context.

questions.question: What is the standard, valid HTML5 syntax for embedding native audio playback?
options: <audio controls><source src='lecture.mp3' type='audio/mpeg'></audio>
<music src='lecture.mp3' controls='true'>
<sound src='lecture.mp3' play controls>
<audio file='lecture.mp3' auto>
questions.explanation: <audio controls> containing nested <source> elements is the standard semantic implementation.

questions.question: What occurs if developer code specifies a <video> element without 'controls' and without 'autoplay'?
options: The audio plays in the background while video is hidden
The video renders as an inert still image that users cannot trigger or navigate
The browser triggers a console fatal exception
The video defaults to launching in an external desktop application
questions.explanation: Without controls or script triggers, the user has no interface to initiate playback, rendering the element inert.

questions.question: Why is it strongly recommended to explicitly define 'width' and 'height' attributes on <video> tags?
options: To reserve layout aspect ratio in advance, preventing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
To reduce server streaming bandwidth by 40%
To auto-adjust playback volume based on screen area
To force high-definition 1080p stream resolution
questions.explanation: Explicit dimensions allow the browser to reserve the required box model area before the video headers arrive.
